BL-1357 — runScenario has no finally, so a resource a Background acquired outlives any scenario that aborts - and the no-handler-match throw it aborts on is raised before the handler, outside every try/catch a step could write
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 from the hardender's rule proposal, which was rejected as
scoped rather than dismissed. The observation was sound and well evidenced;
what it proposed was authoring guidance filed at the role that CATCHES this,
and this ticket is the mechanism that makes the guidance unnecessary. …
Approval context: A new feature file, so it needs a look. No ruling is posed and no ruling_options are declared - how a step signals that it holds something disposable is an implementation shape, and the constraint that matters (exactly-once on every exit path, never masking the original failure) is stated as invari…
BL-1357 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1357" (or "reject BL-1357 <reason>") to act.
